chunks: Al-Ḥalabī narrated from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام that he said:
I see no harm in the rows being between the columns.

key_terms.أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ: Abū ʿAbdillāh, Imam Jaʿfar ibn Muḥammad al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام
key_terms.الصُّفُوفِ: the rows of worshippers in congregational salat
key_terms.الْأَسَاطِينِ: the columns or pillars within a mosque
key_terms.الْحَلَبِيُّ: Al-Ḥalabī, the narrator transmitting this hadith

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible for prayer rows to be between the pillars in congregational salat?
ai.summary: This hadith states that there is no problem with prayer rows being formed between the pillars. It indicates the permissibility of such an arrangement in congregational salat and addresses a practical matter of mosque layout.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.1141 - Al-Halabi narrated from Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) that He said:
"I see no harm in rows (of prayer) being between the columns (pillars)."
